candidates.decision_relevance: Synchronized hourly BTC and ETH prices would make within-week sequencing and rebound magnitude auditable, and help distinguish endpoint summaries from sustained moves across the reviewed analyses.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W37–W45 repeatedly lack underlying hourly observations or path detail; daily reviews also report actual window spans that differ from nominal horizons and a missing 1-hour sequence.
candidates.metric_name: BTC and ETH hourly spot OHLC with UTC timestamps
candidates.missing_history_problem: Weekly returns and uneven, sometimes incomplete API windows do not show when declines, rebounds, and renewed weakness occurred relative to the analyses’ observation cutoffs.

candidates.decision_relevance: A reconstructable breadth history would clarify whether participation broadened or narrowed over time and whether proxy snapshot changes reflect market movement or changing membership.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews repeatedly describe top-100 breadth as proxy-only, with differing point-in-time membership hashes and retrieval times; weekly reviews lack numerical breadth sequences.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped constituent returns and membership for the breadth universe
candidates.missing_history_problem: Advancer/decliner snapshots are not a comparable longitudinal series, so persistence and matched-constituent breadth changes cannot be assessed.

candidates.decision_relevance: A dated sequence of settled BTC and ETH ETF flows would allow flow divergence, persistence, and timing relative to price and breadth changes to be examined.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews report settled-flow detail only through W43 for later weeks; daily reviews repeatedly identify the latest supplied settled session as dated context rather than current flow confirmation.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF net flows
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse, lagged settled-flow observations do not show whether flows persisted, changed direction, or aligned in time with the reviewed price and participation sequences.
